shortDescription: Manage DNS entries on a univention corporate server

options.name: data
options.description: Additional data for this record, for example V({'a': '192.0.2.1'}). Required if O(state=present).

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the record, this is also the DNS record. For example V(www) for www.example.com. For PTR records this has to be the IP address.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the DNS record is present or not.

options.name: type
options.description: Define the record type. V(host_record) is a A or AAAA record, V(alias) is a CNAME, V(ptr_record) is a PTR record, V(srv_record) is a SRV record and V(txt_record) is a TXT record. The available choices are: V(host_record), V(alias), V(ptr_record), V(srv_record), V(txt_record).

options.name: zone
options.description: Corresponding DNS zone for this record, for example V(example.com). For PTR records this has to be the full reverse zone (for example V(1.1.192.in-addr.arpa)).
